name: EVR-AGRI-ENTERPRISE-001
objective: Build a production-oriented enterprise Agricultural Agentic Operating System implementing the supplied master plan: persistent agricultural world state, event-driven intelligence, governed multi-agent operations, integrations, public website, product UI, APIs, auditability, security, and deployable infrastructure.
decisions: Use a modular monolith plus separate workers before splitting into microservices.
Use PostgreSQL/PostGIS as operational source of truth, Timescale-compatible time-series design, Redis for cache/locks, S3-compatible object storage, and an event bus abstraction.
LLMs are reasoning components, never the system of record or deterministic compliance engine.
Every actionable fact carries provenance, observed_at, freshness/TTL, quality, and confidence metadata.
High-risk writes require deterministic policy evaluation and human approval.
External provider objects must be normalized into a proprietary canonical agricultural model.
Provider-specific integrations sit behind capability-oriented connector interfaces.
The product is B2B multi-tenant from day one with organization/farm scoped authorization.
Frontend is Next.js/TypeScript with a control-room visual language; backend is Python/FastAPI; infrastructure is containerized and described as code.
constraints: Do not implement compliance as unconstrained LLM judgment.
Do not let external documents or API text become executable instructions.
Do not expose connector secrets to model context.
Do not trust client-provided tenant identifiers for authorization.
Do not allow critical physical, chemical, payment, or purchase actions without policy/approval gates.
Do not replace the canonical world state with chat history or vector memory.
Preserve protected MASTER_PLAN.md and verify_enterprise.py exactly.
Every stage must preserve all earlier passing capabilities.
failed_attempts: A single giant LLM prompt without stage gates is rejected because it can silently omit enterprise requirements.
A chatbot-first architecture without canonical world state is rejected because it cannot provide auditable operational truth.
blockers: Live third-party API credentials are intentionally unavailable in the benchmark; connectors must provide production adapters plus deterministic mock/sandbox modes.
Physical equipment control is not permitted in benchmark execution; critical action contracts and safety gates must exist without actuating real machinery.

stages.title: Enterprise repository and product foundation
stages.task: Create the enterprise monorepo foundation, architecture documentation, backend/frontend package definitions, local development stack, configuration model, and public product README.
stages.next_action: Establish multi-tenant identity and the canonical agricultural data model.

stages.title: Identity, tenancy, RBAC, and canonical agricultural ontology
stages.task: Implement organization/farm scoped identity and RBAC plus canonical entities for farms, fields, crop cycles, equipment, workers, inventory, livestock, suppliers, contracts, warehouses, and tenant-safe repository boundaries.
stages.next_action: Build agricultural events and persistent world state with provenance and freshness.

stages.title: Event model and persistent agricultural world state
stages.task: Implement the agricultural event envelope, provenance/freshness model, persistent world-state projection, fact confidence metadata, stale-data semantics, timelines, and deterministic state transitions.
stages.next_action: Connect external data sources through normalized connector contracts.

stages.title: Weather, satellite, soil, IoT, machinery, ERP, and regulatory connector layer
stages.task: Implement capability-oriented connectors and normalization boundaries for weather providers, Sentinel/Planet-style satellite sources, SoilGrids-style soil baseline, MQTT/HTTP IoT, Deere-style machinery APIs, ERP, market, and regulatory sources. Include deterministic mock/sandbox implementations.
stages.next_action: Add intelligence, risk, forecasting, vision/satellite analysis interfaces, and optimization.

stages.title: Risk, ML, forecasting, and optimization layer
stages.task: Implement interfaces and reference algorithms for weather/agronomic risk detection, vegetation anomalies, yield/irrigation forecasts, confidence calibration, model registry metadata, and operations scheduling/optimization without using an LLM for deterministic numeric work.
stages.next_action: Build governed tool access, policy evaluation, approvals, and action risk levels.

stages.title: Tool registry, policy engine, approvals, and action safety
stages.task: Implement read/safe-write/controlled-write/critical-write tool classes, deterministic policy decisions ALLOW/DENY/REQUIRE_APPROVAL/REQUIRE_EVIDENCE, action inbox entities, dual approval support, idempotency, and audit-safe action execution contracts.
stages.next_action: Implement the structured multi-agent control plane.

stages.title: Supervisor and agricultural agent workforce
stages.task: Implement structured contracts for Supervisor, Agronomy, Operations, Weather/Risk, Irrigation, Procurement, Logistics, Compliance, Machinery, Finance, and optional Livestock agents; shared blackboard/task workspace; evidence-linked messages; conflict resolution; read/write scopes; escalation rules; and model routing abstraction.
stages.next_action: Implement daily operations, workers, tasks, inventory, scheduling, and farm execution workflows.

stages.title: Farm operations, tasks, workers, machinery, inventory, and workflows
stages.task: Implement operational services for tasks, assignments, workers, machines, inventory, irrigation plans, scheduling, timelines, alerts, and durable workflow definitions suitable for long-running operations and recovery.
stages.next_action: Implement compliance, procurement, supplier, and logistics business modules.

stages.title: Compliance, procurement, finance, logistics, and traceability
stages.task: Implement deterministic compliance checks with evidence hierarchy, product/application constraints, RFQ and supplier comparison flows, procurement approvals, shipment/storage logistics, basic economics, and traceability records.
stages.next_action: Expose tenant-safe APIs, webhooks, and tool/MCP boundaries.

stages.title: Enterprise API, webhooks, tool gateway, and developer platform
stages.task: Implement FastAPI application structure and versioned APIs for farms, fields/state/timeline, recommendations, tasks, agent runs, actions/approvals, integrations, webhooks, health, and developer-facing connector/tool contracts with tenant enforcement.
stages.next_action: Build the public website and core control-room product interface.

stages.title: Public website and agricultural command center
stages.task: Build the Next.js public site and authenticated product shell with control-room visual language. Include Home, Platform, Solutions, Industries, Developers, Resources, Security, Pricing, Company, Book Demo plus Command Center, Map, Today, Ask, Agents, Alerts, Action Inbox, Timeline, farm/field views, and evidence panels.
stages.next_action: Add field onboarding, PWA/mobile workflows, voice capture, and accessibility/responsiveness.

stages.title: Onboarding, geospatial import, PWA/mobile, voice, and field-worker UX
stages.task: Implement onboarding contracts for GeoJSON/KML/SHP/CSV/Excel/manual field drawing, zero-hardware first insight flow, PWA metadata, mobile task views, geolocation/photo/voice structured capture interfaces, and confirmation requirements for ambiguous voice extraction.
stages.next_action: Add security hardening, immutable audit, observability, and evaluation infrastructure.

stages.title: Security, audit, evidence, observability, and AI evaluation
stages.task: Implement immutable audit contracts, external-content untrusted-data boundaries, secret references, encryption/security documentation, OpenTelemetry instrumentation interfaces, agent-run observability, evidence maps, confidence computation from data quality/freshness, and agricultural gold-scenario evaluation fixtures.
stages.next_action: Add production deployment, workflow/event infrastructure, CI/CD, and operational runbooks.

stages.title: Production deployment, durability, eventing, and infrastructure as code
stages.task: Complete container definitions, local and production compose topology, Terraform modules, environment configuration, event-bus and durable-workflow adapters, CI/CD, migrations, backup/restore and incident runbooks, health checks, and deployment documentation.
stages.next_action: Run the final enterprise integration gate and repair every failing requirement.

stages.title: Full enterprise agricultural operating system acceptance
stages.task: Review the entire generated system against MASTER_PLAN.md, fill all missing cross-module integration points, tests, docs, demo/sandbox data, and operator workflows, and ensure the repository is coherent as one enterprise product rather than disconnected scaffolding.
stages.next_action: Deliver the complete audited enterprise build with all deterministic gates passing.
